snippet: Production-grade append-only ledgers use cryptographic integrity verification for system state management, audit trails, and disaster recovery. title: Understanding Event Sourcing and CQRS Pattern | Mia-Platform
snippet: Event Sourcing is an architectural pattern where the system state is reconstructed by replaying events from an append-only log. It tracks changes in a domain by recording them as immutable domain events in an append-only event store. The event sourcing approach is similar to the ledger concept in accounting, with data stored as a sequence of events in an append-only log.
claim: Event sourcing reconstructs state by replaying immutable events from append-only log, mirroring ledger accounting.

title: Event Sourcing: A Practical Guide to Actually Getting It Done | by Sam-Nicolai Johnston | SSENSE-TECH | Medium
snippet: Events are append-only — never updated or deleted, similar to a bank ledger where the ledger records every transaction and the account balance is computed by summing all transactions.
